audit_scope: post-completion raw records; no navigation/solver rerun

measurement_scope.wall: monotonic time around request, including failures, recovery, ACK, final checks and Memory sampler teardown; excludes map/service preparation and post-request exports
measurement_scope.tree_cpu: 20ms sampled cumulative user+system CPU across worker and live descendants; no forced last sample, so last interval may be omitted
measurement_scope.RSS: 20ms sampled sum of worker+descendant RSS; shared pages may be counted more than once; not L2-only/PSS

body_recheck_scope: replay all exported accepted path poses against saved semantic-hard/physical map plus saved L3 allowed scope using original frozen native rectangle checker; continuous sweep certificate checked separately in its bound raw records
traffic_recheck_scope: raw traffic decision, failures and constraint binding; semantic planner is not rerun
